listing.name: OutRun Online Arcade (darkuni Recomp)
listing.summary: Player-managed Windows setup for OutRun Online Arcade using its own Xbox 360 package.

steps.title: Prepare your original in the upstream folder
steps.instruction: With an already permitted Windows x64 copy, keep its files together in a writable folder. Put your own Xbox 360 LIVE package for title 58410968 beside outrun_arcade.exe. The tagged source identifies default.xex 0.0.1.5. Keep the matching media files if using an already extracted assets folder.

steps.title: Use the documented Windows prerequisites
steps.instruction: The package README calls for 64-bit Windows 10 or 11 and the Microsoft Visual C++ 2015–2022 x64 Redistributable when its runtime libraries are missing.

steps.title: Complete first-run setup
steps.instruction: Start outrun_arcade.exe in that folder and let the upstream program prepare assets. Keep your original export separately.

steps.title: Preserve the creating folder
steps.instruction: Keep the generated assets, outrun_arcade.toml and any game-created profile, saves or diagnostic files alongside the creating version.

warnings: Use an already permitted copy. The published license for the upstream project has its own scope, and the package contains translated title code. Fresh acquisition needs attributable permission for that code or a separately reviewed preparation route.
Keep the upstream folder outside the Portcove library. Close the game and its helpers before backing up or replacing the creating runtime and its data.

listing.download_block_reason: Fresh Portcove downloads are held because the selected OutRun Online Arcade executable contains translated title code and the published project license does not establish permission for that separate component. Resume with an attributable applicable grant or a reviewed package or preparation route that resolves it. Independently permitted copies retain their own setup route.
